form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Typed cover page with HANDWRITTEN summary figures; the scan is low-contrast (the page header and footer have faded to near-illegible grey, but the form body and the handwriting are clear). OFFICE PARTIALLY DISAGREES WITH THE INDEX: the Office field reads 'Utah County Commissioner' with NO SEAT LETTER, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat B' - the page does not name a seat and none was inferred. Address is printed and legible (Orem, Utah 84097); only the signature is redacted upstream by the county. Boxes A, B, C and F are written in whole dollars with comma separators and no cents; D, E and the close carry cents. RECONCILIATION FLAG, no correction applied: the form's formula makes Box F = Box A + Box B, i.e. 15,000 + 36,230 = 51,230, but the filer wrote F = 52,230 (which equals Box C and does satisfy close = F - D = 25,135.45). The $1,000 gap sits on Box B, whose second digit is a handwritten glyph I read as a 6 ('36,230') - a 7 would reconcile the page exactly. Transcribed AS READ at medium confidence; NOT adjusted to fit the arithmetic. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.

contributions.note: THE CANDIDATE'S OWN LOAN, written by the filer as the first line of a sheet he headed 'Schedule A Itemized Contributions Received', and INCLUDED in that sheet's own printed '52230 Total Contributions'. It is published as a contribution row because the document's own arithmetic requires it: with the loan the 25 rows sum to exactly the ledger's printed total, to Box C and to Box F; without it they sum to 37,230, a figure that appears NOWHERE on this filing. RECORDED AND NOT ADJUDICATED: the Summary Page separately prints Box A 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' as $15,000 — the same figure — so the filer appears to have counted this one payment both as an opening balance and as a listed contribution. That is the source of the filing's 1,000-dollar ladder inconsistency being impossible to attribute (see recon.contributions.detail); nothing was nudged either way. City cell prints 'Orem/84097' with a slash where the filer's other rows use a space; kept as read, city only. donor_state blank — the ledger has no state column.

contributions.anchor: the filer's own ledger footer '52230 Total Contributions' printed at the foot of his substituted Schedule A sheet — which equals Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' ($52,230) and Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures' ($52,230) on the p4 Summary Page, and does NOT equal the promoted per-period Box B ($36,230)
contributions.detail: THIS IS THE DOCUMENTED ADDENDUM A6 EXCEPTION AND IS FLAGGED LOUDLY: the side closes ONLY on the CUMULATIVE cell. The 25 ledger rows sum to 15000 + 1000 + 500 + 1000 + 1500 + 100 + 500 + 2500 + 1000 + 150 + 2000 + 1000 + 10000 + 100 + 2500 + 200 + 30 + 1000 + 2000 + 3000 + 1000 + 2000 + 150 + 3000 + 1000 = 52,230.00 exactly — equal to the sheet's own printed total, to Box C (year to date) and to Box F. The promoted PER-PERIOD cell, Box B, prints 36,230 and the rows do not reach it under EITHER loan convention: excluding the 15,000 candidate loan gives 37,230 and including it gives 52,230, and neither is 36,230. The filer's own boxes are internally inconsistent by exactly 1,000 — Box F is defined on the form as Box A + Box B, which is 15,000 + 36,230 = 51,230, yet he wrote 52,230 (and then computed his close box correctly from that 52,230: 52,230 - 27,094.55 = 25,135.45, exactly what the close box prints). So a single 1,000 discrepancy sits somewhere between Box A, Box B and Box F, it is NOT attributable to any ledger row (the rows close perfectly on their own printed total), and NOTHING WAS NUDGED. The label is cumulative-exact rather than delta because the rows do reconcile exactly — to a printed figure of a different SCOPE. Downstream this leaves reconciles_contributions BLANK = unknown rather than True, which is the correct outcome. Note for a later reader: index.csv retains only ONE 2026 Spencer filing, so no earlier report exists in this module against which the period/cumulative split could be examined, and NO figure was differenced across covers to synthesize one.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($27094.55) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also the filer's own printed ledger footer '27094.55 Total Expenditures' and is printed identically as Box E (year to date)
expenditures.detail: The 19 ledger rows sum to 901.5 + 2000 + 520.24 + 23.68 + 20.58 + 74.7 + 94.72 + 796.68 + 80.59 + 483.54 + 3406.87 + 401.08 + 13900 + 753.22 + 21.46 + 1016.18 + 2200 + 320.87 + 78.64 = 27,094.55 exactly = the sheet's own printed total = the promoted per-period Box D. Box D and Box E print the IDENTICAL figure on this filing, so the period and cumulative scopes coincide on the expenditure side and the closure holds on the promoted per-period cell without any scope caveat. Note the asymmetry with the contribution side, which is a real property of this document and not an extraction artifact: the filer reported his whole-cycle expenditures as 'this period' while splitting his contributions into a 15,000 opening balance plus a period figure.

itemized.notes: FORM CHARACTERISATION (2026 stock, fifth specimen — and the first in this chunk where THE COUNTY SCHEDULES ARE NOT USED AT ALL). The cover (p1) and the Summary Page (p4) are the county's modern_boxAF form, footer 'v. 12.23', masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'; pp2 and 3 are the FILER'S OWN TYPED LEDGERS substituted for Schedule A and Schedule B — the ADDENDUM E5 portrait own-ledger shape. Both sides are therefore 'transcribed' and NEVER 'no-schedule-page': what is missing is the county's printed grid, not the filer's entries. His ledgers reproduce the county's own column vocabulary closely (Date / Name of Contributor / City/Zip Code / Amount and Date / Provider/Vendor / Purpose / Amount), each ends in a single printed total line, and each is hand-signed and hand-foliated at the foot in ink ('David M. Spencer / 6/15/2026 / Page 2' and '... Page 3'). Foliation is continuous counting the cover (Pages 1-4). NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this document. The Summary Page's figures are ALL HANDWRITTEN on an otherwise typed form, and its close box is UNLETTERED. Report type 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' is ticked, the amendment question is ticked 'No', report date 6/15/2026. *** THE FILING'S ONE REAL ANALYTIC HAZARD, stated plainly: the CONTRIBUTION ledger is CYCLE-SCOPED and closes only on the cumulative cells (Box C and Box F, both 52,230), while the EXPENDITURE ledger closes on the promoted per-period Box D (27,094.55, which this filer also prints as Box E). One filing, two different scopes, one per side. On top of that the summary ladder is internally inconsistent by exactly 1,000: Box F should be Box A + Box B = 15,000 + 36,230 = 51,230 and the filer wrote 52,230. The 1,000 cannot be attributed to any ledger row — the rows close perfectly on their own printed totals — so nothing was nudged and both figures are retained verbatim. A downstream reader must NOT treat this filing's contribution rows as an increment. *** THE LOAN: the ledger's first line is 'David Spencer Loan ... 15000' and Box A prints the identical $15,000 as the balance at beginning. The ADDENDUM B3 ladder test was run in both directions and neither reaches Box B, so the row is published because the sheet's own printed 'Total Contributions' includes it (dropping it would leave 37,230, a figure that appears nowhere on the filing). The apparent double-count between Box A and the row is recorded and NOT adjudicated. PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: cover, affirmation line, and both ledger sheets' ink signatures read 'David M. Spencer', matching index.csv. The OFFICE BOX reads 'Utah County Commissioner' AND NAMES NO SEAT — index.csv's 'County Commission Seat B' is a CHANNEL attribution this document does not corroborate, and no seat is inferred here (the wave rule against inferring a commission seat the filing does not print). REDACTION — A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH FLAGGING: this file is named '_Redacted' and the county blacked out ONLY the signature block on the cover. The candidate's full home street address, his phone number and his email are all published IN THE CLEAR in the cover's Address row, and the two ledger sheets carry no redaction at all. A FILENAME IS NOT EVIDENCE OF REDACTION (ADDENDUM I6) and here the converse also holds: the '_Redacted' name understates what remains visible. Nothing from that row is carried into this record. No DONOR address exists to redact anywhere on this filing, because the filer's own ledger asks only for a city and a zip. SCAN QUALITY: the p1 cover's page header and footer have faded to near-illegible grey and the p4 summary's header likewise, but the form bodies, the typed ledgers and the handwritten box figures are all crisp. Both ledger pages are bilevel CCITT images at 300 dpi with no text layer, so every value here was read from a render and row confidence stays at the OCR tier 'medium' per SCHEMA §6.
